headline: Missing structure is an unanswered question, not a rejection
recommendation: Retain the published RNA-supported case and leave protein interpretation unresolved. Missing structure and pilot non-detection are not biological negatives.

claims.text: The primary paper specifically reports confirmation of the Cd274–Lacc1 junction and its LPS responsiveness.
The reconstructed pair is reported NanoString-supported, while assay testing and per-probe QC fields remain unknown.
The independent Parabricks re-check found zero matching probe-junction reads in the bounded two-million-pair sample.
No candidate-specific predicted structure is available in the structure manifest.
These artifacts do not establish a translated Cd274–Lacc1 protein or its function. A missing model is not evidence that no protein exists.

next_action.question: Is the published junction reproducible in the new sample or condition of interest?
next_action.first_step: Review the primary paper and the exact probe sequence with the scientist before choosing the matched sample and assay.
next_action.proposed_experiment: Use junction-specific RNA confirmation with sequence confirmation in an independent matched sample; pursue protein analysis only after resolving the full candidate sequence.
next_action.discriminating_outcome: A confirmed junction addresses RNA presence under the tested condition, while translation and function remain separate questions.

author.mode: Active assistant chose and executed bounded tools, read returned evidence, and authored this decision; no Responses API call or autonomous background LLM loop claimed.

claim_review.scope: Qualitative source-support review, not an independent biology reviewer signoff
claim_review.note: The primary passage explicitly names this pair. Missing structure is scoped to this project. NanoString unknown-QC semantics and bounded non-detection are preserved.

limitations: Three selected demonstration cases; no prospective or blinded evaluation.
No human time-saving or clinical/experimental utility measurement.
Recommendations are proposals requiring scientist review; no experiment was executed.
